name: Oil-to-oil bushing interface reference
summary: Identifies the selected insulated conductor passage between the documented oil-insulated compartments.
description: Identifies the selected insulated conductor passage between the documented oil-insulated compartments. High-voltage primary equipment carries, interrupts, measures or conditions the main power circuit. Its function, insulation arrangement and equipment boundaries need to be distinguished from the secondary signals used to control it.

In a switchyard equipment diagram, the primary reference identifies the electrical role of an installed component while the linked equipment schedule and manufacturer drawing supply its exact construction and dimensions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “First oil-insulated connection” at the input and “Second oil-insulated connection” at the output. Compartment construction must be identified.
